name: Custom Node Shapes
description: An example of custom node shapes for a study with children. The things in a child's world are drawn with a picture chosen by a "type" attribute. One node type uses pictures with their own colours; the other uses pictures drawn in the theme colours and the node type's colour.

content.en:
We are going to make a picture of **your world**: the people, places, animals and things that matter to you.

There are no right or wrong answers. You can skip anything you do not want to talk about.

label.en: Who and what is in your world?

prompt.en: What do you call them or it?
What kind of thing is it?

text.en: Who and what is **important to you**? Add each one, and choose what kind of thing it is.
Put the things that matter **most** to you in the middle. Then tap two things to join them up if they **go together**.

title.en: The same shapes in theme colours

content.en: _For researchers._ The next two screens repeat the task with a second node type. Its shapes are drawn with the theme colours and the node type's own colour (`var(--node-color)`), so they follow the interview theme.

prompt.en: What do you call them or it?
What kind of thing is it?

text.en: Add a few more things from your world, and choose what kind of thing each one is.
Put the things that matter **most** to you in the middle. Then tap two things to join them up if they **go together**.

finishConfirmation.en: Are you sure you want to finish the interview?

finishFailed.en: The interview could not be finished. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the study organizer.

content.en:
# Finish Interview

You have reached the end of the interview. If you are satisfied with the information you have entered, you may finish the interview now.

finishedContent.en:
# Interview Finished

Thank you for participating!

exitInterviewDescription.en: Your answers so far will be saved and you can continue later.

exitFailed.en: Your answers could not be saved, so the interview has not been closed. Please try again. If the problem continues, contact the study organizer.

exitReviewDescription.en: Changes made during this review will not be saved.

hiddenScreenDescription.en: This screen is hidden based on the answers given so far. Do you want to show it anyway?

outsidePathDescription.en: This screen is outside the current interview path based on the answers given so far. Do you want to show it anyway?

stageError.en:
# There was an error

There was an error with the interview software, and this task could not be displayed.

Some tasks, such as maps, need an internet connection, so check your connection and then try refreshing the page.

If the problem persists, please contact the study organizer and send them the debug information, which you can copy with the button below. You may be able to continue your interview by clicking the next button.
